verdict.rationale: OpenCode advertises multi-session support for running multiple agents in parallel on the same project, desktop tabs, and serve/attach for connecting clients to running backends. A community user reports the WebUI can connect to multiple OpenCode backends at once, which corroborates a unified workspace. Another user reports bugs restoring session state and agents getting stuck in long or nested sessions, which is a reliability caveat. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the multi-session management workflow (session list/switching, oversight of parallel agents), evidence that session management is reliable across sessions and projects.
